definitions.explanation: A deep, often quiet sadness or grief. A literary word conveying profound emotional pain, frequently used in writing and formal expression.

examples.japanese: {悲哀|ひあい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{悲哀|ひあい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{込|こ}められている→込める：01945_komeru⟧。
examples.english: Deep sorrow is embedded in that music.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悲哀|ひあい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}いた→描く：02013_egaku⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: A novel that depicted the grief of war stayed with me.

notes:
A literary word composed of {悲|ひ} (sad, sorrowful) + {哀|あい} (grief, pity). Both characters independently convey sadness; together they express profound, quiet grief. Common in literature, music criticism, and formal writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悲哀|ひあい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧: filled with sorrow
- {悲哀|ひあい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel sorrow
- {悲哀|ひあい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{帯|お}びた→帯びる：12428_obiru⟧: tinged with sorrow
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悲哀|ひあい}: the sorrow of life

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧: sadness — the most common everyday word
- ⟦{哀愁|あいしゅう}→哀愁：04838_aishuu⟧: melancholy, pathos — similar literary register, but with a more wistful, nostalgic quality
- {嘆|なげ}き: lamentation — active grieving, more vocal
- ⟦{哀|あわ}れ→哀れ：01775_aware⟧: pathos, pity — a classical aesthetic concept in Japanese literature

REGISTER:
Primarily a written/literary word. In everyday conversation, ⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧ or {悲|かな}しさ would be used instead.
